idea-plugin.name: LO-TEK
idea-plugin.description:
Completion and diagnostics for the LO-TEK design system in HTML, including HTML injected into a string.

The web-types.json file shipped with @lo-tek/interfaces already gives completion in plain HTML files without this plugin. It is not read for injected fragments, though: markup that lives in a Kotlin or TypeScript string marked with @Language("HTML") or // language=HTML. This plugin closes that gap, reading the classes from the same manifest the diagnostics check against, the project's own when it has one, so the completion and the diagnostics never disagree.

Diagnostics come from LO-TEK's own checker, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly and run inside the IDE with Chicory, a pure Java runtime: unknown elements, classes, attributes and values, and the wiring a template has to write itself, with quick fixes where the checker has one. No Node.js is needed. Live templates insert each component's markup from the documentation, with the id as a variable.

Source code (MIT)

Norsk: Fullføring og feilmeldinger for LO-TEK i HTML, også i HTML som er injisert i en streng merket med @Language("HTML").
